description: This file defines the Vtiger_PackageExport class responsible for exporting vtiger CRM modules and their related files as XML configuration and zip archives, including module metadata, tables, fields, views, dependencies, actions, related lists, custom links, events, and scheduled cron tasks.

classes.name: Vtiger_PackageExport
classes.description: A class providing API to package and export vtiger CRM modules, including generating XML metadata and creating zip archives.

methods.name: Vtiger_PackageExport
methods.description: Constructor method initializing export temporary directory.

methods.name: openNode
methods.description: Outputs the opening tag for an XML node.

methods.name: closeNode
methods.description: Outputs the closing tag for an XML node.

methods.name: outputNode
methods.description: Outputs an XML element with optional node wrapping.

methods.name: __write
methods.description: Writes value to the XML manifest file.

methods.name: __getManifestFilePath
methods.description: Generates the filepath for the temporary manifest XML file.

methods.name: __initExport
methods.description: Initializes export by creating the manifest XML file.

methods.name: __finishExport
methods.description: Closes the manifest file.

methods.name: __cleanupExport
methods.description: Deletes temporary manifest file.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Main method to export a module as a zip file, including metadata and associated files.

methods.name: export_Dependencies
methods.description: Exports version dependency information for a module.

methods.name: export_Module
methods.description: Exports core module metadata and related configuration information.

methods.name: export_Tables
methods.description: Exports database table information related to the module.

methods.name: export_Blocks
methods.description: Exports UI blocks and associated fields.

methods.name: export_Fields
methods.description: Exports detailed information for each field within a block.

methods.name: export_CustomViews
methods.description: Exports custom view configurations.

methods.name: export_SharingAccess
methods.description: Exports default sharing permissions for the module.

methods.name: export_Events
methods.description: Exports event hooks associated with the module.

methods.name: export_Actions
methods.description: Exports available actions (tools) for the module.

methods.name: export_RelatedLists
methods.description: Exports related list configurations.

methods.name: export_CustomLinks
methods.description: Exports custom links defined for the module.

methods.name: export_CronTasks
methods.description: Exports scheduled cron task configurations for the module.
